cover_front

Front cover art for the children's picture book "The Snail Mail Express". Story: In the bustling canopy of Whisperwood Hollow, everyone is in a hurry—except eight-year-old Clara and her giant, cottage-shelled snail, Barnaby! Together, they run The Snail Mail Express, delivering lost forest treasures that speedy creatures leave behind. When three mysterious, unaddressed parcels appear in the mossy drop-box—a silver dewdrop thimble, a ticking acorn watch, and a perforated birch-bark melody—Clara and Barnaby set out down Fern-Fiddle Lane. Along the way, they prove that slowing down isn't falling behind: it's the secret to noticing what matters most.
